tldr: Venus in Aries: love is direct, passionate, and sparked by aliveness.
body: With Venus in Aries, attraction moves quickly and wants honesty, excitement, and pursuit. You value desire that feels immediate and brave.
gift: Bold affection, romantic courage, creative heat, and the ability to ask for what you want.
challenge: Impulsiveness, competitiveness, and losing interest when the chase becomes intimacy.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
